prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1469; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle was turning left and was struck by a vehicle proceeding straight through on the opposing green. Claimant reports left shoulder pain following airbag deployment. Photos of both vehicles requested from the insured and the police report number confirmed. No attorney on file for the claimant.

Entry 2: Spoke with the claimant by phone. Claimant states they were the driver of the straight-through vehicle and believe the left-turning vehicle entered the intersection too early. Claimant has been seen at an urgent care clinic and is awaiting referral to an orthopedic provider for the shoulder. Claimant confirmed they have not retained counsel and asked how the claim process works. Provided general information about the bodily injury and property damage steps and sent the written claim packet.

Entry 3: Reviewed the scene diagram in the responding officer's report. Officer noted skid marks from the straight-through vehicle and a statement from the left-turning driver that the signal had been amber. Signal timing records for the intersection requested from the city. Liability currently appears to be disputed and will be evaluated once the timing records arrive.

Entry 4: Received medical records from the urgent care visit. Diagnosis lists a strained left shoulder with limited range of motion and a recommendation for physical therapy. No fracture identified on imaging. Claimant has not yet scheduled the orthopedic follow-up. Sent a reminder letter to the claimant with the list of approved providers and a request for ongoing treatment notes.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with the claimant to check on treatment progress. Claimant reports attending the first physical therapy session and still experiencing pain when lifting the arm above shoulder height. Claimant again confirmed no legal representation. Reserve reviewed and adjusted based on the current medical picture. Liability position remains under review pending the signal timing data. Next check-in scheduled for two weeks from the call.
